uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3099-4762-6774-8320.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Yoshimaru and Loading Zone.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

1084-2842-4279.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
1084-2842-4279.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Blood Artist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
1084-2842-4279.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

3499-3755-4770-5301.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2044-3899-6972.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Peema Outrider.
When Peema Outrider dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Peema Outrider enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

222-527-2079-4247.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-2079-4247.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

3558-4053-6495-6989.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.
3558-4053-6495-6989.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3010-3259-6968.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3010-3259-6968.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Moonblade Shinobi, triggering Breath of Fury and Moonblade Shinobi.
Resolve the Moonblade Shinobi trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1115-3259-7795.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1115-3259-7795.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Drider, triggering Breath of Fury and Drider.
Resolve the Drider trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

206-215-6478.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with toughness 6 or greater.
206-215-6478.description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Arbor Adherent from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Arbor Adherent by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1394-2060-5256-7038-7267.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Michelangelo.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Michelangelo.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 10 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

803-6291-7304.description:
Cast Genghis Frog either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {G}{U} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Genghis Frog enters, it triggers, creating a Mutagen token and a creature token due to Stridehangar Automaton.
When the creature token enters as a Mutant due to Arcane Adaptation, Genghis Frog triggers, creating a Mutagen token and a creature token due to Stridehangar Automaton.
Repeat step 3.
803-6291-7304.notes: Step 3 creates a mandatory infinite loop that will cause the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.

2060-3497-4518-6930.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 1 life this turn.
2060-3497-4518-6930.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {W}.
Spider-Man India triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

864-4067-4306-6281.description:
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Eternal Witness.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Eternal Witness that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Eternal Witness token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Eternal Witness from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Nyx Lotus.
Repeat.

4944-5115-5390.description:
Activate Gemstone Array's first ability by paying {1}.
Crackdown Construct triggers, getting +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve Gemstone Array's ability, putting a charge counter on it.
Activate Gemstone Array's second ability by removing a charge counter from it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1849-3259-5768.notablePrerequisites:
Origin of the Hidden Ones has exactly two lore counters on it.
You control at least one Assassin that does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1849-3259-5768.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Origin of the Hidden Ones triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
Origin of the Hidden Ones' third chapter ability triggers, causing you to create an Assassin token whenever an Assassin attacks this turn and sacrifice Origin of the Hidden Ones.
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached, and at least one Assassin if the creature with Breath of Fury attached isn't an Assassin, as attackers.
Origin of the Hidden Ones triggers, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token that's tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

2178-4395-5368.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
2178-4395-5368.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

1912-3371-4896-5299.notablePrerequisites: Codie does not have summoning sickness.
1912-3371-4896-5299.description:
Activate Codie by paying {2} and tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate High Alert by paying {W}{U}, untapping Codie.
Repeat.
Once you have an arbitrarily large number of Codie triggers, you may cast any instant or sorcery spell by paying its mana cost.
Codie triggers for each time you activated its ability.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to exile cards from the top of your library until you exile an instant or sorcery spell with lesser mana value, and allowing you to cast that spell without paying its mana cost.
Repeat step 6 for each remaining trigger.
You may also repeat this combo for each instant and/or sorcery card in your hand, and on subsequent turns.

1939-2966-3253-4613.notablePrerequisites:
Zopandrel has at least one indestructible counter on it, and at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
You control at least one additional permanent.
1939-2966-3253-4613.description:
Activate Zopandrel using Myojin of Blooming Dawn's ability by removing an indestructible counter from it, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token for each permanent you control.
When the Spirits enter the battlefield, Lunarch Veteran triggers that many times, causing you to gain that much life.
Activate Zopandrel by paying 4 life and sacrificing two Spirits, putting an indestructible counter on it.
Repeat.
If you control at least two additional permanents as the combo starts, this combo nets infinite lifegain and creature tokens.

2559-3263-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Brilliant Halo, adding {2}.
Brilliant Halo triggers, returning itself to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Brilliant Halo by paying {2}, attaching it to a creature you control.
Repeat.

2284-4050-4343.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional untapped creature.
2284-4050-4343.description:
Activate Glare of Subdual by tapping an untapped creature you control, tapping a creature an opponent controls.
Hylda of the Icy Crown triggers, holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature tapped in step 1, adding {1}.
Resolve the Hylda of the Icy Crown trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 4/4 Elemental creature token.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this loop during each turn.

262-859-1818.notablePrerequisites:
Lurking Roper does not have summoning sickness.
Elemental Mastery attached to Lurking Roper.
262-859-1818.description:
Activate Lurking Roper by tapping it, creating four 1/1 Elemental creature tokens.
When the Elementals enter the battlefield, they trigger Healer of the Pride four times.
Resolve the first Healer of the Pride trigger, causing you to gain two life.
Lurking Roper triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

4050-4980-5037-5220.notablePrerequisites: Anje does not have summoning sickness.
4050-4980-5037-5220.description:
Activate Anje by tapping it and discarding Blazing Rootwalla.
Blazing Rootwalla is discarded into exile due to its madness ability.
Anje and Blazing Rootwalla trigger.
Resolve the Anje trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blazing Rootwalla trigger, causing you to pay {0} to cast it from exile.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Blazing Rootwalla, adding one mana of any color.
When Blazing Rootwalla dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Blazing Rootwalla on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Anje ability from step 1, causing you to draw Blazing Rootwalla from the top of your library.
Repeat.

224-1264-1846-4782.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least four untapped Islands.
Heidar does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least four snow permanents.
224-1264-1846-4782.description:
Cast High Tide by paying {U}.
Activate four Islands by tapping them, adding {U}{U}{U}{U}.
High Tide triggers, adding {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Parallax Tide by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Activate Parallax Tide four times by removing four fade counters from it, exiling the four tapped Islands.
Activate Heidar by paying {2} and tapping it, returning Parallax Tide from the battlefield to your hand.
When Parallax Tide leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
When the Islands enter the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers four times, untapping Heidar, and allowing you to untap up to three other creatures you control and/or scry 1 up to three times.
Repeat from step 2.

1267-4050-4147-5114.notablePrerequisites:
Owlbear Cub and Hua Tuo do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls at least eight lands and is unable to block and kill your creatures.
1267-4050-4147-5114.description:
Activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting Medomai on top of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your combat phase, and declare Owlbear Cub as an attacker, attacking the opponent with eight or more lands.
Owlbear Cub triggers, causing you to look at the top eight cards of your library, put Medomai onto the battlefield tapped and attacking, and put the remaining cards on the bottom of your library.
Deal combat damage with Owlbear Cub and Medomai.
Medomai triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Medomai, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat each turn.

1322-3304-4289-4772-4963.description:
On your upkeep, activate Words of Wilding by paying {1}.
On your draw step, create two Bear tokens.
Activate two Bear tokens by tapping itself, adding one mana of any color.
Activate World of Wilding by paying {2}.
Activate Greater Good by sacrificing a Bear token, creating four Bear tokens and discarding three cards.
Activate two Bear tokens by tapping those, adding two mana of any colors.
Repeat from step 4.

413-2646-3026-4302.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional Angel.
Bloodspore Thrinax has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
413-2646-3026-4302.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing an Angel.
Bishop of Wings triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token that enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter.
The Spirit token enters the battlefield as a 4/4 Spirit Angel due to having a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Blasting Station and Bishop of Wings.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping itself.
Resolve the Bishop of Wings trigger, causing you to gain four life.
Resolve Blasting Station's ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Blasting Station by sacrificing the Spirit token.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2367-3000-3490.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}.
Unruly Mob triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, costing you {1} to create a 1/1 Servo and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Repeat.

1183-2178-2773-4061.notablePrerequisites:
Dalakos does not have summoning sickness.
Pentavus has at least two +1/+1 counters.
Thornbite Staff attached to Dalakos.
1183-2178-2773-4061.description:
Activate Dalakos by tapping it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent on artifacts or to activate abilities of artifacts.
Activate Pentavus's first ability by paying {1}, creating a 1/1 Pentavite creature token.
Warstorm Surge triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Pentavus's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing a Pentavite, putting a +1/+1 counter on Pentavus.
Dalakos triggers, untapping.
Repeat.
